landing.subtitle: May 2026 — version 1.0
landing.preamble_body: Thanks for attending the meeting of May 14th. This questionnaire formalizes your individual positioning so we can build Happy Cash on solid ground adapted to each person's reality.
landing.rule_honest: Be honest about what you can give today, not what you would ideally want to give. A lower level you can keep is better than a higher level betrayed in 3 months.
landing.rule_no_judgment: No answer is judged. Level 4 (Friend of the collective) is as respectable as Level 1 (Founder).
landing.rule_confidential: Your answers are confidential. They will only be shared with the other future Founders when the legal entity is incorporated.
landing.rule_editable: You can edit your answers until May 20th. After that, they are frozen for the 2nd meeting.

errors.submit_failed: Submission failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

login.title: Happy Cash vote area
login.subtitle: Enter the email tied to your account. You will get a secure login link valid for 24h.
login.sent_body: If this address is registered, a login link has just been sent. Don't forget to check your spam folder.

errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or malformed.
errors.token_expired: This link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.token_used: This link has already been used. Request a new one.

list.title: My votes
list.load_error: Could not load votes. Try again.
list.empty: No active vote for your profile. You will be notified by email when the next one opens.

detail.anonymity_disclosure: Your vote is technically dissociated from your identity at submission. During the voting period, a server compromise could theoretically reveal your choice. This guarantee becomes absolute after the vote closes.
detail.already_voted_body: Your participation has been counted. You will receive the results by email when the vote closes.
detail.closed_no_vote: This vote is closed. You did not participate.
detail.cast_help_multiple: You can select up to {{max}} options.

errors.not_eligible: You are not eligible for this vote.

ballot.comment_placeholder: You can briefly explain your choice…

success.title: Vote recorded
success.body: Thanks for taking part. You will receive the results by email when the vote closes.
success.receipt_help: Note this code. When the vote closes, find it in the published results PDF to confirm your ballot was counted.

results.title: Results
results.empty: No results to display for this vote.

errors.results_hidden: The results of this vote are reserved to the administrator.
errors.results_pending_close: Results will be visible once the vote closes.
errors.must_vote_first: You must cast your ballot before viewing the results.
errors.not_eligible: You are not eligible for this vote.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: 10-year retention of every action on the vote system (never the ballot content).

voters.title: Voters management
voters.confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this voter? They will no longer be able to sign in or vote.

create.title: Create a new vote
create.mode_open: Open (each ballot tied to its author)
create.open_at_helper: If empty and 'open immediately' checked: opens on click.
create.close_at_helper: If empty: manual close by an admin.
create.scheduled_hint: This vote will open automatically at the chosen date via the scheduler (runs every minute).
create.multi_round: Multi-round (top N goes to round 2 if no majority)
create.open_immediately: Open the vote right after creation

detail.opened_ok: Vote opened. Eligible voters can now cast their ballot.
detail.closed_ok: Vote closed. The results PDF has been emailed to the administrator.
detail.confirm_close: Close this vote now? This action cannot be undone.

success.title: Thanks for your contribution!
success.subtitle: Your positioning has been recorded.
success.body: You will receive a PDF copy of your answers at the email address you provided. The administrator also receives your submission. See you at the 2nd meeting on May 23rd.
